/* REXX - Hello World */
SAY 'Hello World'
What is VSAM?

VSAM (Virtual Storage Access Method) is IBM's high-performance file access method. Types:

1. KSDS - Key Sequenced Dataset (indexed by key)
2. ESDS - Entry Sequenced Dataset (sequential)
3. RRDS - Relative Record Dataset (by slot number)
4. LDS - Linear Dataset (for DB2, etc.)

VSAM provides:
- Fast random and sequential access
- Automatic space management
- Index maintenance
- Alternate indexes for secondary access paths

Managed via IDCAMS utility.
What is JES2?

JES2 (Job Entry Subsystem 2) manages batch job processing in z/OS:

1. Job Input - Reads JCL from readers
2. Job Scheduling - Queues jobs by class/priority
3. Job Execution - Initiates jobs on available initiators
4. Output Processing - Routes SYSOUT to printers/writers
5. Spooling - Manages spool datasets

JES2 commands start with $ (e.g., $DA, $DQ)
NJE enables job networking between systems.
Write CICS COBOL with temporary storage queue

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSTSQ.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-QUEUE-NAME       PIC X(8) VALUE 'MYQUEUE'.
       01 WS-DATA             PIC X(100).
       01 WS-LENGTH           PIC S9(4) COMP VALUE 100.
       01 WS-ITEM             PIC S9(4) COMP.
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'TEST DATA FOR QUEUE' TO WS-DATA
           EXEC CICS WRITEQ TS
               QUEUE(WS-QUEUE-NAME)
               FROM(WS-DATA)
               LENGTH(WS-LENGTH)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           MOVE 1 TO WS-ITEM
           EXEC CICS READQ TS
               QUEUE(WS-QUEUE-NAME)
               INTO(WS-DATA)
               LENGTH(WS-LENGTH)
               ITEM(WS-ITEM)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write COBOL with STRING statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. STREXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FIRST-NAME       PIC X(10) VALUE 'JOHN'.
       01 WS-LAST-NAME        PIC X(10) VALUE 'DOE'.
       01 WS-FULL-NAME        PIC X(25).
       01 WS-POINTER          PIC 99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1 TO WS-POINTER
           STRING WS-FIRST-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE
                  ' ' DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  WS-LAST-NAME DELIMITED BY SPACE
               INTO WS-FULL-NAME
               WITH POINTER WS-POINTER
           END-STRING
           DISPLAY 'FULL NAME: ' WS-FULL-NAME
           STOP RUN.
Write REXX with DO loop

/* REXX - Loop examples */
TOTAL = 0

/* DO with counter */
DO I = 1 TO 10
   TOTAL = TOTAL + I
   SAY 'I =' I 'TOTAL =' TOTAL
END

/* DO WHILE */
COUNT = 0
DO WHILE COUNT < 5
   COUNT = COUNT + 1
   SAY 'COUNT =' COUNT
END

/* DO UNTIL */
NUM = 0
DO UNTIL NUM >= 3
   NUM = NUM + 1
   SAY 'NUM =' NUM
END
EXIT 0

Write CICS COBOL with START command for browse

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSBROW.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD           PIC X(100).
       01 WS-KEY              PIC X(10).
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       01 WS-EOF              PIC 9 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'A' TO WS-KEY
           EXEC CICS STARTBR
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               GTEQ
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 1
               EXEC CICS READNEXT
                   FILE('CUSTFILE')
                   INTO(WS-RECORD)
                   RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
                   RESP(WS-RESP)
               END-EXEC
               IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(ENDFILE)
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-EOF
               ELSE
                   EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
                       FROM(WS-RECORD)
                   END-EXEC
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           EXEC CICS ENDBR FILE('CUSTFILE') END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write COBOL to read VSAM KSDS file

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. READVSAM.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT VSAM-FILE ASSIGN TO VSAMFILE
               ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
               ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC
               RECORD KEY IS VS-KEY
               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD VSAM-FILE.
       01 VSAM-RECORD.
          05 VS-KEY           PIC X(10).
          05 VS-DATA          PIC X(90).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FILE-STATUS      PIC XX.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT VSAM-FILE
           MOVE '0000000001' TO VS-KEY
           READ VSAM-FILE
               INVALID KEY
                   DISPLAY 'RECORD NOT FOUND'
               NOT INVALID KEY
                   DISPLAY 'DATA: ' VS-DATA
           END-READ
           CLOSE VSAM-FILE
           STOP RUN.
Write CICS COBOL with HANDLE CONDITION

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSHNDL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD           PIC X(100).
       01 WS-KEY              PIC X(10).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EXEC CICS HANDLE CONDITION
               NOTFND(NOT-FOUND-PARA)
               DUPKEY(DUP-KEY-PARA)
               ERROR(ERROR-PARA)
           END-EXEC
           MOVE 'KEY001' TO WS-KEY
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('MYFILE')
               INTO(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
       NOT-FOUND-PARA.
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT FROM('RECORD NOT FOUND')
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
       DUP-KEY-PARA.
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT FROM('DUPLICATE KEY')
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
       ERROR-PARA.
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT FROM('ERROR OCCURRED')
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.

Write COBOL with COMPUTE statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. COMPUTE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NUM1             PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 100.50.
       01 WS-NUM2             PIC 9(5)V99 VALUE 25.25.
       01 WS-RESULT           PIC 9(7)V99.
       01 WS-PERCENTAGE       PIC 9(3)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           COMPUTE WS-RESULT = WS-NUM1 + WS-NUM2
           DISPLAY 'SUM: ' WS-RESULT
           COMPUTE WS-RESULT = WS-NUM1 * WS-NUM2
           DISPLAY 'PRODUCT: ' WS-RESULT
           COMPUTE WS-PERCENTAGE = 
               (WS-NUM2 / WS-NUM1) * 100
           DISPLAY 'PERCENTAGE: ' WS-PERCENTAGE
           STOP RUN.

Write COBOL with PERFORM VARYING loop

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. LOOPEXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-INDEX            PIC 99.
       01 WS-TOTAL            PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-INDEX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-INDEX > 10

Write COBOL with SEARCH statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SRCHEXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-TABLE.
          05 WS-ENTRY OCCURS 5 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-IDX.
             10 WS-CODE       PIC X(3).
             10 WS-DESC       PIC X(20).
       01 WS-SEARCH-CODE      PIC X(3).
       01 WS-FOUND-FLAG       PIC 9 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'A01' TO WS-CODE(1)
           MOVE 'FIRST ITEM' TO WS-DESC(1)
           MOVE 'B02' TO WS-CODE(2)
           MOVE 'SECOND ITEM' TO WS-DESC(2)
           MOVE 'C03' TO WS-CODE(3)
           MOVE 'THIRD ITEM' TO WS-DESC(3)
           MOVE 'B02' TO WS-SEARCH-CODE
           SET WS-IDX TO 1
           SEARCH WS-ENTRY
               AT END
                   DISPLAY 'NOT FOUND'
               WHEN WS-CODE(WS-IDX) = WS-SEARCH-CODE
                   DISPLAY 'FOUND: ' WS-DESC(WS-IDX)
           END-SEARCH
           STOP RUN.

What is a PDS?

PDS (Partitioned Dataset) is a z/OS dataset containing members:

1. Directory - Lists all members
2. Members - Individual named components
3. Similar to folders with files

PDSE (Extended) improvements:
- Dynamic directory expansion
- Better space management
- Member generations

Common uses:
- Source libraries (COBOL, JCL)
- Load libraries (executables)
- Procedure libraries (PROCs)
- Copybooks and macros

/* REXX - Parse example */
INPUT_STRING = 'JOHN,DOE,35,ENGINEER'

PARSE VAR INPUT_STRING FIRST ',' LAST ',' AGE ',' JOB

SAY 'First Name:' FIRST
SAY 'Last Name:' LAST
SAY 'Age:' AGE
SAY 'Job:' JOB

/* Parse with template */

Explain z/OS dataset naming conventions

z/OS dataset naming rules:

1. Maximum 44 characters total
2. Qualifiers separated by periods
3. Each qualifier: 1-8 characters
4. First character: A-Z, @, #, $
5. Remaining: A-Z, 0-9, @, #, $, -

Examples:
- SYS1.PARMLIB
- USER01.COBOL.SOURCE
- PROD.DAILY.EXTRACT.D240115

High-Level Qualifier (HLQ):
- First qualifier identifies owner
- TSO users: userid is default HLQ
- RACF controls HLQ access
Write REXX with SELECT WHEN

/* REXX - SELECT example */
GRADE = 'B'

SELECT
   WHEN GRADE = 'A' THEN
      RESULT = 'Excellent'
   WHEN GRADE = 'B' THEN
      RESULT = 'Good'
   WHEN GRADE = 'C' THEN
      RESULT = 'Average'
   WHEN GRADE = 'D' THEN
      RESULT = 'Below Average'
   WHEN GRADE = 'F' THEN
      RESULT = 'Failing'
   OTHERWISE
      RESULT = 'Invalid Grade'
END

SAY 'Grade:' GRADE 'Result:' RESULT
EXIT 0
What is ISPF?

ISPF (Interactive System Productivity Facility) is the primary z/OS user interface:

1. Panel-Based - 3270 screen navigation
2. PDF (Program Development Facility)
   - Option 1: Browse
   - Option 2: Edit
   - Option 3: Utilities
   - Option 4: Foreground (compile)
   - Option 5: Batch
   - Option 6: Command (TSO)

ISPF provides:
- Dataset management
- Member editing with syntax highlighting
- Job submission and output viewing
- Customizable panels and tables
What is RACF?

RACF (Resource Access Control Facility) is IBM's security product for z/OS mainframes. It provides:

1. User Authentication - Validates user IDs and passwords
2. Access Control - Controls who can access datasets, programs, and resources
3. Auditing - Logs security events for compliance
4. User/Group Management - Organizes users into groups with shared permissions

RACF protects resources through profiles that define access rules.

What is SMF?

SMF (System Management Facilities) collects z/OS system activity data:

1. Record Types - Numbered 0-255
   - Type 30: Job/step data
   - Type 70-79: RMF data
   - Type 101: DB2 data
   - Type 110: CICS data

2. Uses:
   - Performance analysis
   - Capacity planning
   - Chargeback/billing
   - Security auditing

3. Processing:
   - IFASMFDP to dump records
   - SMF exits for real-time processing
   - Tools: RMF, SAS, custom programs

/* REXX - Function example */
NUM1 = 10
NUM2 = 20

SUM_RESULT = ADD_NUMBERS(NUM1, NUM2)
SAY 'Sum of' NUM1 'and' NUM2 'is' SUM_RESULT

MAX_RESULT = FIND_MAX(NUM1, NUM2)

ADD_NUMBERS: PROCEDURE
   ARG A, B
   RETURN A + B

FIND_MAX: PROCEDURE
   ARG A, B
   IF A > B THEN RETURN A

Write COBOL with DB2 WHENEVER for error handling

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2ERR.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-DATA             PIC X(100).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EXEC SQL
               WHENEVER SQLERROR GOTO ERROR-PARA
           END-EXEC
           EXEC SQL
               WHENEVER NOT FOUND GOTO NOTFOUND-PARA
           END-EXEC
           PERFORM MAIN-PROCESS
           STOP RUN.
       MAIN-PROCESS.
           EXEC SQL
               SELECT * INTO :WS-DATA
               FROM MYTABLE
               WHERE KEY = '001'
           END-EXEC.
       NOTFOUND-PARA.
           DISPLAY 'RECORD NOT FOUND'
           STOP RUN.
       ERROR-PARA.
           DISPLAY 'SQL ERROR: ' SQLCODE
           DISPLAY 'SQLSTATE: ' SQLSTATE
           EXEC SQL ROLLBACK END-EXEC
           STOP RUN.

X = LISTDSI("'"DSNAME"'")

What is TSO?

TSO (Time Sharing Option) provides interactive access to z/OS:

1. Command Line - Execute TSO commands
2. ISPF - Panel-based interface (ISPF/PDF)
3. Dataset Management - ALLOCATE, FREE, DELETE
4. Program Development - Edit, compile, test
5. REXX - Scripting for automation

Common TSO commands:
- LISTCAT - List catalog entries
- LISTDS - List dataset attributes
- ALLOCATE - Allocate datasets
- SUBMIT - Submit batch jobs
- EXEC - Run REXX or CLISTs
What is CICS?

CICS (Customer Information Control System) is IBM's transaction processing monitor. Features:

1. Online Transaction Processing - Handles thousands of concurrent users
2. Screen Management - BMS maps for 3270 terminals
3. File Access - VSAM, DB2, IMS
4. Program Control - LINK, XCTL, RETURN
5. Recovery - Automatic transaction backout
6. Security - RACF integration

CICS programs use EXEC CICS commands embedded in COBOL, PL/I, or Assembler.
Write COBOL with embedded SQL SELECT

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2SEL.

Write CICS COBOL with REWRITE command

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSRWRT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-RECORD.
          05 WS-KEY           PIC X(10).
          05 WS-DATA          PIC X(90).
       01 WS-RESP             PIC S9(8) COMP.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'KEY001' TO WS-KEY
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               INTO(WS-RECORD)
               RIDFLD(WS-KEY)
               UPDATE
               RESP(WS-RESP)
           END-EXEC
           IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               MOVE 'UPDATED DATA' TO WS-DATA
               EXEC CICS REWRITE
                   FILE('CUSTFILE')
                   FROM(WS-RECORD)
                   RESP(WS-RESP)
               END-EXEC
           END-IF
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
Write COBOL with OCCURS table

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. TABLEEXM.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-TABLE.
          05 WS-ITEM OCCURS 10 TIMES.
             10 WS-NAME       PIC X(20).
             10 WS-VALUE      PIC 9(5)V99.
       01 WS-INDEX            PIC 99.
       01 WS-TOTAL            PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-INDEX FROM 1 BY 1
               UNTIL WS-INDEX > 10
               MOVE 'ITEM' TO WS-NAME(WS-INDEX)
               MOVE WS-INDEX TO WS-VALUE(WS-INDEX)
               ADD WS-VALUE(WS-INDEX) TO WS-TOTAL
           END-PERFORM
           DISPLAY 'TOTAL: ' WS-TOTAL
           STOP RUN.

               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD INPUT-FILE.
       01 INPUT-RECORD        PIC X(80).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-FILE-STATUS      PIC XX.
       01 WS-EOF-FLAG         PIC 9 VALUE 0.
          88 END-OF-FILE      VALUE 1.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN INPUT INPUT-FILE
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               READ INPUT-FILE
                   AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END
                       DISPLAY INPUT-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           CLOSE INPUT-FILE
           STOP RUN.

Write CICS COBOL with SEND MAP and RECEIVE MAP

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSMAP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       COPY CUSTMAP.
       01 WS-COMM-AREA        PIC X(100).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           IF EIBCALEN = 0
               EXEC CICS SEND MAP('CUSTMAP')
                   MAPSET('CUSTSET')
                   ERASE
               END-EXEC
           ELSE
               EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('CUSTMAP')
                   MAPSET('CUSTSET')
                   INTO(CUSTMAPI)
               END-EXEC
               PERFORM PROCESS-INPUT
           END-IF
           EXEC CICS RETURN
               TRANSID('CUST')
               COMMAREA(WS-COMM-AREA)
           END-EXEC.
Write CICS COBOL with ASKTIME and FORMATTIME

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CICSTIME.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-ABSTIME          PIC S9(15) COMP-3.
       01 WS-DATE             PIC X(10).
       01 WS-TIME             PIC X(8).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EXEC CICS ASKTIME
               ABSTIME(WS-ABSTIME)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS FORMATTIME
               ABSTIME(WS-ABSTIME)
               MMDDYYYY(WS-DATE)
               DATESEP('/')
               TIME(WS-TIME)
               TIMESEP(':')
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
               FROM(WS-DATE)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.

Write CICS COBOL with LINK to another program

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.

       01 WS-COMM-AREA.
          05 WS-REQUEST       PIC X(10).
          05 WS-RESPONSE      PIC X(100).
       01 WS-LENGTH           PIC S9(4) COMP VALUE 110.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.

Write COBOL with EVALUATE statement

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. EVALEXMP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-GRADE            PIC X.
       01 WS-RESULT           PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'B' TO WS-GRADE
           EVALUATE WS-GRADE
               WHEN 'A'
                   MOVE 'EXCELLENT' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN 'B'
                   MOVE 'GOOD' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN 'C'
                   MOVE 'AVERAGE' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN 'D'
                   MOVE 'BELOW AVERAGE' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN 'F'
                   MOVE 'FAILING' TO WS-RESULT
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'INVALID GRADE' TO WS-RESULT
           END-EVALUATE
           DISPLAY 'RESULT: ' WS-RESULT
           STOP RUN.

Write COBOL with DB2 cursor

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DB2CURS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC.
       01 WS-EMP-ID           PIC X(6).
       01 WS-EMP-NAME         PIC X(30).
       01 WS-EOF              PIC 9 VALUE 0.
           EXEC SQL
               DECLARE EMP_CURSOR CURSOR FOR
               SELECT EMPNO, FIRSTNME
               FROM EMPLOYEE
               WHERE WORKDEPT = 'D11'
               ORDER BY EMPNO
           END-EXEC.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EXEC SQL OPEN EMP_CURSOR END-EXEC
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 1
               EXEC SQL
                   FETCH EMP_CURSOR
                   INTO :WS-EMP-ID, :WS-EMP-NAME
               END-EXEC
               IF SQLCODE = 100
                   MOVE 1 TO WS-EOF
               ELSE
                   DISPLAY WS-EMP-ID ' ' WS-EMP-NAME
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           EXEC SQL CLOSE EMP_CURSOR END-EXEC
           STOP RUN.
